notes.title: Great news from Tiny Bull Studios!
notes.content:
Hey Gamers! 👁️✨

Great news from Tiny Bull Studios! We're thrilled to share updates about our exciting upcoming projects:

🔍 Omen Exitio: Hunger is nearing completion! We're just moments away from announcing the official release date. Expect an immersive narrative adventure packed with over 900 stunning illustrations, and a cinematic sound design that will pull you deeper into its dark mysteries. If you loved Omen Exitio: Plague, prepare yourself for an even richer, more intense storytelling experience.

✨ The Lonesome Guild (in collaboration with our friends at Don't Nod!) is also making fantastic progress and is set to release this autumn. Expect a fresh, captivating story-driven experience!

Can't wait? Neither can we! Try out the Omen Exitio: Hunger Demo now on Steam, and don't forget to leave your valuable feedback—your thoughts help us make the game even better!

✅ Wishlist both games now and join us as we count down the days to launch.

Thank you for your amazing support! Stay tuned—there's more excitement coming soon!

— Tiny Bull Studios 🐃

notes.title: Thank you all!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Omen fans!

We're here with a big smile on our faces. During the Steam Next Fest, you showed incredible support by playing our demo and sharing your valuable feedback.

The Steam Next Fest was an overwhelming success, with thousands of you downloading and experiencing our adventure. It was a pleasure to see how deeply you immersed yourselves in our dark and mysterious world! We want to thank each of you who took the time to play the demo and for the extraordinary compliments you shared.

Your feedback has been incredibly valuable. We carefully read every comment you shared, both the positive ones and those that pointed out bugs and other flaws. We're pleased to know that most of you had a positive experience, and for those who encountered bugs, rest assured that we're working hard to fix them.

We would love to have your continued support, so if you enjoyed playing the demo, please add Omen Exitio: Hunger to your Steam Wishlist to stay updated on its development and future release.

Thank you again for being a part of our amazing community. Without you, none of this would be possible. Keep sharing your excitement and thoughts with us. We look forward to sharing more adventures and horrors with you!

With love,
The Tiny Bull Studios Team

notes.title: The demo of Omen Exitio: Hunger will be available at the Visual Novel Fest!
notes.content:
Omen Exitio: Hunger will be the protagonist at the Steam Visual Novel Fest! This exciting event celebrates the art of storytelling through images and interactive stories, bringing a unique experience to all players and literature lovers.

The Visual Novel Fest will take place from August 7th to August 14th and promises to be an extraordinary experience. This special event highlights games that excel in interactive storytelling, offering a combination of textual narrative and evocative images that will immerse you in the heart of the plot.

But that's not all! From the beginning of this event, the playable demo of Omen Exitio: Hunger will be available! It will be the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the dark and fascinating world of our game, exploring a gripping and mysterious story while trying to unveil all its secrets.

We can't wait to share this extraordinary experience with you and to receive your valuable feedback during the Visual Novel Fest. Your participation and support will be crucial for the future development of Omen Exitio: Hunger and will enable us to take the game to the next level!

Omen Exitio: Hunger demo available from 7th August, 7:00 PM at the link below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466520/Omen_Exitio_Hunger

notes.title: A LITTLE BIG ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Dear friends and fans of Tiny Bull Studios, today we have big news to share with you!

After months of hard work and reflection, we have decided to change the name of our beloved video game "Omen Exitio: 1927" to "[b]Omen Exitio: Hunger[/b]" to better fit the anthology format of the series!

We are excited to unveil the [b]new game logo[/b], which perfectly captures the dark and immersive atmosphere of the world we have created. You can see it on all our Social!

We are curious to hear your thoughts on the name change. What does it suggest to you? Why do you think we chose this name? [b]Share your theories[/b] in the comments below and let's uncover the mysteries together! Remember our first chapter, "Omen Exitio: Plague"? This is just the beginning of an epic saga!

Thank you for your continued support and for joining us on this extraordinary journey. We can't wait to show you all the surprises that "Omen Exitio: Hunger" has in store for you!

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to dive into an even more thrilling and haunting gaming experience.

notes.title: We are launching our own subreddit!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245714/45ac138ca98365579afbebe6c134d62f47315e2e.png[/img]


Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce the creation of a subreddit dedicated to Tiny Bull Studios' videogames and projects! The subreddit will be a place where all videogame enthusiasts can discuss our projects, share their opinions and suggestions, and keep updated on the latest news from our company.

We would like to invite all video game fans to participate in the discussions and share their passion with the community. The subreddit will be moderated by members of the Tiny Bull Studios team and our most passionate fans, so make sure to abide by the subreddit rules and maintain a friendly and respectful environment.

In addition, we will use the subreddit as a channel to provide users with early information on our ongoing projects and to gather feedback and ideas from the community.

We can't wait to see what the community thinks and to start discussing our projects with all of you. See you in the Tiny Bull Studios subreddit!

Subreddit link: https://www.reddit.com/r/TinyBullStudios

See you soon!

Tiny Bull Studios
